The Blue Raiders, led by 12th year head coach [[Kermit Davis]], played their home games at the [[Murphy Center]] and were first year members of [[Conference USA]]. They finished the season 24–9, 13–3 in C-USA play to finish in a four way tie for the C-USA regular season championship. They advanced to the semifinals of the [[2014 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]] where they lost to Tulsa.
